subject: Marketplace sell-through ops & publisher onboarding model
messages:
From: Beth Coleman <beth@tieredconsulting.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-team@nebula-analytics.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace seller support & onboarding pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Nebula's marketplace team asked me to scope a short pilot to prove sell-through velocity for ISV listings that include a managed services component (our typical consulting + integration offering). High level ask: can Redwood provide a lightweight publisher support SLA and a drafted onboarding bundle we can attach to the marketplace listing so buyers see a predictable integration path?

Quick context: Nebula runs a three-week PoC for customers and prefers a published "publisher setup" doc and an SLA for onboarding fixes (e.g., data connector issues, telemetry mapping). They want clear delivery and billing expectations so procurement can sign off.

What we'd like from Redwood for the pilot
- A one-page publisher onboarding checklist we can link in the listing
- An SLA window for priority onboarding (target: 2 business days for triage)
- A simple fee map for co-billing or reseller passthrough (ballpark numbers are fine)

I've attached a sample template Nebula uses and an internal estimate from our engineering team. Can you share who on your side would own publisher support for a co-sell listing?

Attachments: [publisher_onboarding_template.pdf] [marketplace_fee_model.xlsx]

Thanks,
Beth Coleman
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Tiered Consulting
beth@tieredconsulting.com | +1 206 555 0104

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Beth Coleman <beth@tieredconsulting.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller support & onboarding pilot

Beth — thanks for the clear brief. This is a practical ask and good framing for co-sell listings that include services. Quick notes:

- We can deliver a one-page publisher onboarding checklist and a short SLA addendum for marketplace listings.
- For triage SLA (2 business days) we'd scope a "publisher support tier" that sits on top of our normal platform support; it includes an assigned partner enablement contact and a 2-business-day triage SLA for integration blockers.
- Fee map: our Partnerships team prefers a simple revenue share for software + an MRR for managed work; I'll share a conservative ballpark in the next message.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll put you in touch with our enablement lead (Vivek) to review the onboarding checklist and SLA language.
2) Monica from Partnerships Ops will validate how we map fees into marketplace catalog fields and invoicing cadence.
3) We'll produce a draft onboarding doc + SLA and return it within 5 business days.

Can we sync a 30-min call early next week to review the draft and align on the Nebula procurement questions? I'm free Mon/Tue mornings PST.

Ben Carter
Director, Cloud Alliances
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Beth Coleman <beth@tieredconsulting.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller support & onboarding pilot

Thanks Beth — this matches a recurring ask from our larger ISV partners. A couple practical guardrails from our side:

- Publisher onboarding checklist (deliverable):
  • Pre-flight: model & infra requirements, network/VPC notes, expected token throughput, minimal test dataset
  • Integration: connector config, telemetry keys, sample pipeline manifest
  • Verification: smoke tests, latency targets, cost-estimate for typical 30-min session
  • Handoff: who to contact at Redwood, escalation matrix, expected response windows

- SLA: we can offer a 2-business-day triage SLA for onboarding defects as part of a paid "publisher enablement" SKU. Production incident SLAs will remain separate and subject to Dedicated/Private commitments.

- Marketplace fee flow: see attached example fee table (we'll convert this into the marketplace SKU structure). For pilot: propose a 70/30 revenue split (Redwood/Partner) on software, and an hourly pass-through for managed services. We can be flexible in negotiation.

I've uploaded a starter draft to Drive for you to edit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-publisher-onboarding

Can the Nebula engineering contact confirm they are comfortable with the three-week PoC cadence referenced? If so we'll bake timing into the checklist and the DocuSign flow.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0177
[Attachment referenced: marketplace_fee_model.xlsx]

From: Beth Coleman <beth@tieredconsulting.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-team@nebula-analytics.com, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace seller support & onboarding pilot

Ben / Vivek — appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft. Nebula's engineering lead (cc'd) confirmed the three-week PoC cadence is fine. A couple small asks from procurement:

- Can the onboarding doc include an explicit list of data retention and telemetry fields collected during the PoC? They need it for their privacy team.
- Can we surface the billing cadence on the one-pager (monthly vs. invoice-on-completion) so procurement knows how to map to their AP system?

If you can add those two items to the Drive doc, we can get legal and procurement queued and aim for a signed pilot SOW within two weeks. We're good to book a 30-min review Monday 9/21 10:00 AM PST if that works for your team.

Onwards —
Beth Coleman
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Tiered Consulting
beth@tieredconsulting.com | +1 206 555 0104
